svg.text: In the cloud, open. In the blaze, close.
Voyage 5.1, Act 2: the weather is the music; the curves are the phase A model's (one run each)
the rule player builds 12 sugars: the bud needs 12
the rule keeps it standing; always-open lets it droop four times; always-closed keeps it standing but builds nothing.
Judged (5 of 6 to master): in each silent cloud, open more than in the blaze before and build at least 2 sugars;
in each silent blaze, never droop and have at most 2 of 6 doors open in its second half.
Random taps rarely dry the leaf but get the timing wrong (doors open in the blaze, shut in the cloud): the beats judge the timing.
